entry.title: MMR: Mixed media textures bundle
entry.summary: Proyecto por Elsa Roran con 6 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Elsa Roran

MMR — Mixed Media Research is a series of experimental textures created through physical materials and real printing processes. Everyday objects are used as processing tools, and the results are captured through repeated printing and scanning.
The bundle combines textures made using paper, tape, fire, glue, reverse prints, and analog glitches. All distortions and artifacts are the result of real material interactions — no digital simulations.
